title: Saleor: reconciled commerce
summary: Carry selected variants and quantities into an inspectable cost breakdown and a recoverable checkout review.
use_when: A buyer must choose a product configuration and inspect the complete amount before a recoverable checkout commitment.
avoid_when: The primary task is marketing discovery alone, or a real payment, tax or inventory contract is required from this local specimen.
